all.src: IV rank >= 30 measured over the trailing 252 days. Below 20, skip -- the credit does not pay for the tail.
Directional gate: last close < 20-EMA, OR short strike is at least 1.0 ATR(14) above the highest high of the last 10 sessions.
Net credit >= 33% of spread width (a $5-wide must pay >= $1.65). If the market will not pay it, widen the strike or skip the trade.
Max loss per position (width*100 - credit) <= 2% of account equity = $1,000 on $50k.
Both legs OI >= 500, bid/ask <= 10% of mid.
Both legs OI >= 500, bid/ask <= 10% of mid.

management.src: Take profit: buy back the spread at 50% of max profit (spread mid <= 0.50 * credit received).
Time-based exit: close at 21 DTE regardless of P/L if not already closed at the profit target. Gamma risk past 21 DTE is not compensated.
Stop loss: close if the spread's mark reaches 2.0x the credit received (i.e., unrealized loss = 1x credit), or if the underlying trades through the short strike -- whichever comes first.
Stop loss: close if the spread's mark reaches 2.0x the credit received (i.e., unrealized loss = 1x credit), or if the underlying trades through the short strike -- whichever comes first.

exits.src: Hard rule: the position must be flat by 15:45 ET on expiration day, without exception.

ASSIGNMENT GUARD: if at 15:30 ET on expiration day the underlying is above (short strike - $0.05), close the whole spread immediately. Pin risk at the short strike is the single largest source of accidental assignment.
ASSIGNMENT GUARD: on any day, if the short call is ITM and its extrinsic value < $0.10, close the spread that session.
DIVIDEND GUARD: if the short call is ITM and its extrinsic < 1.5 * the pending dividend, close the spread by the close of the session before ex-dividend.
DIVIDEND GUARD: if the short call is ITM and its extrinsic < 1.5 * the pending dividend, close the spread by the close of the session before ex-dividend.
